guidance.summary: You sit right at the group average on every habit, so the picture is the same as most people in this cluster: short and low-quality sleep, high stress, and low activity compared with the wider data. The numbers themselves are not unusual for you, but the pattern of poor sleep, high stress, and low movement is worth working on together.
recommendations: Set a fixed lights-out time and a wind-down routine without screens for the 30 minutes before bed to nudge sleep duration up.
Add one short walk after lunch or dinner most days, aiming to lift daily steps by about a thousand from where they are now.
Pick one five-minute breathing or slow-exhale exercise each evening to help bring the stress level down alongside better sleep.
Keep one weekly activity slot, like a longer walk or light sport, to slowly raise your overall activity level.
